changes.before: Roles describe useful connections, not limits. Every resource stays open to everyone.

changes.before: Five minutes: agree on one small change to try, and who will check back.
changes.after: Five minutes: decide what to retain, test or investigate further, within the team’s authority, and who will follow up.

changes.before: An action plan for the change the team agreed to try.
changes.after: A brief record of the agreed next step, its reasons and who will follow up.

changes.before: Two minutes: what would we do differently on our real decision?
changes.after: Two minutes: what reasoning should we carry into the real decision, and what still needs checking?

changes.before: A note in the team's own files on what you would do differently.
changes.after: A note in the team’s appropriate working files on the reasoning, remaining questions and responsible next step.

changes.before: Ten minutes: which requirements truly predict success in this job?
changes.after: Ten minutes: which requirements are necessary for the work, and what evidence supports them?

changes.before: Ten minutes: plan accommodations offered up front, without asking anyone to disclose.
changes.after: Ten minutes: plan accessible interviews and explain how candidates can request an accommodation through the authorized process.

changes.before: Five minutes: offer interpreters and accommodations in the invitation.
changes.after: Five minutes: confirm available access supports and explain how people can request interpreters or accommodations.

changes.before: The invitation itself, and a short note of what was heard and what changed.
changes.after: The invitation and a report-back plan explaining what was heard, what changed, what remained unchanged and why.

changes.before: Ten minutes: plan who outside the team will test the revised version.
changes.after: Ten minutes: decide whether revision is needed and how to test comprehension with intended readers, preserving required wording and procedures.

changes.before: Ready-to-run sessions for a regular staff meeting. Each one has a time, an agenda, the material to open and what the team keeps afterward. Nothing about who attends is recorded.
changes.after: Adapt these session plans for a regular staff meeting. Each includes suggested timing, an agenda, related material and a proposed working record. This page does not collect attendance; follow your team’s requirements for any official meeting record.

changes.after: A record of the review, the decision and its reasons, kept through the appropriate process.
